items.title: Eddie Metz Jr. interviewed by Monk Rowe, New Hartford, New York, October 3, 2015
items.q: then Greg Fields was there for two years and then I was there for six months... Just to sit from the drums and to look down from where the drums were and look down and see Count Basie at the piano

ctx.x: Yeah. I had all my information on the cassette. And what had happened was Grover was listening to it on the bus and he said, “hey Basie, here, listen to this.” Because Greg Fields was getting ready to leave. Maybe we could check this guy out. I had big band stuff on there. And he said yeah sure. So Basie called me personally. I said, “who is this?” Who’s messing with me, you know? And then I recognized his voice it was like oh my gosh.
Did he call himself Count? Do you recall?
